title: Sections of pulled-back differentials over a fixed source point
statement: Let k be a field, f:Y -> Spec k smooth, and c:B -> Spec k any scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-fibre-product]. Let U be an open of Y, z a point of U, K=kappa_U(z), and T any scheme. Suppose h:T -> Spec K and g:T -> B times_k Y satisfy g composed with the source projection = h composed with Spec K -> U -> Y [def-pc-scheme-fibre]. Let A=Gamma(T,O_T) and alpha:K -> A be the global-section map of h. Write p:B times_k Y -> B and use ordinary tensor module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. There is an injective A-linear map D:A tensor_K bertiniCotangentFibre(f,U,z) -> Gamma(T,g^*Omega_p) [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf, lem-zl-bertini-local-first-jets]. For every source open W containing U.ι(z), every a in Gamma(Y,W), every b in A, and every proof that g maps T into V=pr_Y^{-1}(W), D sends b tensor the differential component of the local first jet of a to b times the restriction to T of g^*(d(pr_Y^*a)). No section family, invertible sheaf, universal equation, or singular-locus hypothesis is present.

proof.text: Obtain a source-fibre differential map with the displayed pure-tensor formula from the comparison theorem, then apply the separate injectivity theorem.

proof_origin.place: Differential base-change comparison and injectivity decomposition

theorem exists_source_fibre_differential_sections
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {Y B T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f] (c : B ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (U : Y.Opens) (z : U)
    (h : T ⟶ Spec ((U : Scheme).residueField z)) (g : T ⟶ pullback c f)
    (hg : g ≫ pullback.snd c f = h ≫ (U : Scheme).fromSpecResidueField z ≫ U.ι)
    (α : (U : Scheme).residueField z →+* Γ(T, ⊤))
    (hα : α = ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso ((U : Scheme).residueField z)).inv ≫ h.appTop).hom) :
    let K := (U : Scheme).residueField z
    let A := Γ(T, ⊤)
    letI : Algebra K A := α.toAlgebra
    ∃ D : (A ⊗[K] bertiniCotangentFibre f U z) →ₗ[A]
        Γ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj (pullback.fst c f).relativeDifferentials, ⊤),
      Function.Injective D ∧
      ∀ (W : Y.Opens) (hz : U.ι z ∈ W)
        (hV : (⊤ : T.Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ ((pullback.snd c f) ⁻¹ᵁ W))
        (a : Γ(Y, W)) (b : A),
        D (b ⊗ₜ[K] (bertiniLocalFirstJet f U z W hz a).2) =
          b • ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj
            (pullback.fst c f).relativeDifferentials).presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op
              (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackSection g (pullback.fst c f).relativeDifferentials
                ((pullback.snd c f) ⁻¹ᵁ W)
                ((pullback.fst c f).relativeDifferentialsDerivation.d
                  (X := Opposite.op ((pullback.snd c f) ⁻¹ᵁ W))
                  ((pullback.snd c f).app W a)))
